## HeuristicTablePluginConfig.fontWeightCoeffs property

How much wider text renders at a given font weight than at a regular one, keyed by the stringified `fontWeight`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
fontWeightCoeffs?: FontWeightCoefficients;
```

## Remarks

Merged over the defaults rather than replacing them, so `{ bold: 1.05 }` retunes bold text alone and leaves the numeric weights as they were. A weight with no entry, before or after merging, costs nothing. Pass a referentially stable object — a fresh literal on every render relays out every table using it.
